scope: Attention only on actual layer3 queries, selected positions and referenced main KV pages; no selector, projections, cache writes, model, or HTTP.
timing_scope: Captured CUDA events bracket all attention groups for the complete saved workload. Native driver replay. Preparation, CPU readback and reference excluded.
cache_reconstruction: Kernel inputs preserve original physical page IDs and block table. CPU reference alone remaps recorded pages bijectively into compact storage.

independent_reference.arithmetic: FP32 QK, FP32 softmax, FP32 PV, BF16 output; exact installed callable.

limitations: Single checkpoint, one layer, one exact 262136-token prompt and its saved last prefill/decode operands.
Attention-only CUDA event timings exclude selection, projection, cache writes, model, scheduler, HTTP, preparation and CPU readback.
Capacities partition or pad the same logical rows; they do not represent independent model-batch throughput.
S16/S32/S64 use installed low-level split/merge. Direct1 has no split merge and is not candidate fixed-S1.
Capacity128/512 split cases allocate full-capacity partials; a public path bounded to64rows would use the measured segmented64 case.
Independent sparse reference uses FP32 probabilities and PV, which differs from Transformers BF16-probability attention.
Passing the existing sparse-reference0/.02 gate does not establish full-model logit/token parity.
Per-case clocks/power were not measured; two-run raw event timings and process-boundary telemetry are retained.
